name: sres_bsf_approved_source
title: Corporate Library / Protected Gateway approved-source package policy (Corporate)
summary: Third-party packages come from Corporate Library Corporate Package Index or Protected Gateway-approved indexes via PIP_INDEX_URL. Missing package → request onboard or drop feature. Core RAG-DAG is stdlib and works headless with zero pip packages. Shipping a prebuilt wheel kit is never the primary enterprise model.

approved_indexes.label: AWS CodeArtifact / Government Cloud approved index

install_order: Set PIP_INDEX_URL / PB_PIP_INDEX_URL (and usually PIP_TRUSTED_HOST) to Corporate Library or Protected Gateway approved remote via corporate-package-index.env
SETUP / Install-PrivateBrain installs optional deps only from that index
If package not in Corporate Library / Protected Gateway → request onboarding; do not scrape public PyPI in enterprise
If optional feature still missing → headless pilot remains valid (core is stdlib)
vendor/wheels is never primary; not required in freeze zip; emergency Corporate Package Index-origin only if policy allows

freeze_for_corporate.primary_deps_path: Corporate Library / Protected Gateway PIP_INDEX_URL (or PB_PIP_INDEX_URL)
freeze_for_corporate.local_wheels: optional last-resort cache only; never required
freeze_for_corporate.destination_path: extract → corporate-package-index.env (Corporate Library / Protected Gateway) → SETUP/START → beastMode --enterprise (headless OK)
do_not: Treat offline wheel kit as the Corporate delivery model
pip download public PyPI into vendor/wheels as the freeze default
Require vendor/wheels for SETUP or enterprise pilot

setup_policy.allow_public_pypi_when: dev laptop only (PB_ENTERPRISE unset and PB_PIP_REQUIRE_ARTIFACTORY unset)

fail_if: freeze_for_corporate downloads or stages public-PyPI wheels as the primary kit contents
docs state Corporate is fully offline or must ship wheels
enterprise SETUP falls back to public PyPI when PB_ENTERPRISE=1
pass_if: Corporate Library / Protected Gateway PIP_INDEX_URL is the documented install path
missing package → request onboard or headless
core stdlib headless enterprise is documented as production-valid
